changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Register the Trino federated query gateway for real cross-database joins between the PG warehouse and legacy MySQL.
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO analytics_database ( name, engine, database_role, details_json, description, is_sample, timezone, metadata_sync_schedule, cache_field_values_schedule, auto_run_queries, is_full_sync, is_on_demand, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT '联邦查询入口', 'trino', 'BUSINESS_PRIMARY', '{ "jdbc-url":"jdbc:trino://${DTS_TRINO_HOST:dts-trino}:${DTS_TRINO_PORT:8080}/postgres/public", "user":"${DTS_TRINO_USER:copilot}", "logicalSourceAliases":["prs.flowerbiz.federated","prs.flowerbiz.trino"], "federatedQuery":true, "queryContract":{ "engine":"trino", "catalogs":["postgres","mysql"], "requiresQualifiedTables":true, "joinRequiresWhereOrLimit":true } }', 'Trino federated gateway for PRS flowerbiz cross-database joins.', false, 'Asia/Shanghai', null, null, true, true, false, ${now}, ${now} WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analytics_database WHERE lower(name) = lower('联邦查询入口') );
UPDATE analytics_database SET engine = 'trino', database_role = 'BUSINESS_PRIMARY', details_json = '{ "jdbc-url":"jdbc:trino://${DTS_TRINO_HOST:dts-trino}:${DTS_TRINO_PORT:8080}/postgres/public", "user":"${DTS_TRINO_USER:copilot}", "logicalSourceAliases":["prs.flowerbiz.federated","prs.flowerbiz.trino"], "federatedQuery":true, "queryContract":{ "engine":"trino", "catalogs":["postgres","mysql"], "requiresQualifiedTables":true, "joinRequiresWhereOrLimit":true } }', description = 'Trino federated gateway for PRS flowerbiz cross-database joins.', is_sample = false, timezone = 'Asia/Shanghai', metadata_sync_schedule = null, cache_field_values_schedule = null, auto_run_queries = true, is_full_sync = true, is_on_demand = false, updated_at = ${now} WHERE lower(name) = lower('联邦查询入口');
